component.name: RadarNebo
component.summary: Drone and missile threats over Ukraine on a live map

description.p: RadarNebo shows active air-raid alerts and the drones and missiles behind them on a map of Ukraine. Select a target to see its type, its track so far and where it is predicted to go next, and save the places you care about to be flagged when a threat comes near.
Tracks and predictions are estimated from public alerts and warnings. They are not official warnings: always follow the air-raid alerts of your region.

screenshot.caption: A cruise missile's track and predicted route
